summary: Adds updater review re-checks, generated image-update Compose stabilization, and terminal image-handoff recovery. DjangoLux now consumes composer's token-matched exit acknowledgement when deploy status is unavailable, clears failed maintenance immediately, and generated maintenance pages return to the application automatically after recovery. Inline-safe: Python, template, JavaScript, scaffold, i18n, docs, and tests only; no migration.
highlights: Adds a re-check icon inside the DjangoLux update review modal.
Repaints or closes the modal after the existing superuser-only check endpoint finishes.
Uses token-matched composer acknowledgements as an independent terminal handoff signal.
Returns generated maintenance pages to the application automatically after failed-update recovery.
Keeps generated composer-updater services on Composer latest while excluding the updater and socket gateway from update scope.
Enables Docker socket-proxy EVENTS=1 for Compose update progress.
